verdict.rationale: Notion's own homepage states 'Get answers, instantly—with citations,' which matches the story directly: an instant AI answer with citations. The Agent session APIs (stream an Agent's reply) and the MCP search over Notion and connected sources add some support that an AI layer queries workspace content. However, the core evidence is a single marketing tagline. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how Q&A citations work (which content is cited and how sources are linked), confirmation that answers are grounded in the user's own workspace, and independent or hands-on corroboration of answer and citation quality.
